## Installation

THE REAL McCOIL categorical and proportional methods are included in the [`PGEcore`](https://github.com/PlasmoGenEpi/PGEcore) R package. The C code is compiled when the package is installed, so you do not need to clone the [EPPIcenter repository](https://github.com/EPPIcenter/THEREALMcCOIL) or run `R CMD SHLIB` yourself.

`PGEcore` is installed from GitHub:


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("PlasmoGenEpi/PGEcore")
```
:::


Convergence diagnostics use the [`posterior`](https://mc-stan.org/posterior/) package. `PGEcore` lists it under Suggests, so install it as well:


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
install.packages("posterior")
```
:::


Package documentation, including the SNP-calls table this wrapper expects, is in the [PGEcore site](https://plasmogenepi.github.io/PGEcore/) (`vignette("input-formats", package = "PGEcore")`).

### A compiler

Installing `PGEcore` compiles the McCOIL C sources, so you need the same build tools as any R package with compiled code:

* Windows: install [Rtools](https://cran.rstudio.com/bin/windows/Rtools/) for your version of R, and allow it to update your system PATH
* macOS: install the Xcode Command Line Tools with `xcode-select --install`
* Linux (Debian/Ubuntu): `sudo apt-get install r-base-dev`
